text: My daily routine is quite simple and consistent. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a quick shower. After breakfast, I begin work at nine and stay focused until noon. I take a short lunch break, then continue working until around five. In the afternoon, I try to exercise for about thirty minutes, either jogging or doing yoga. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch some TV, or read a book. I go to bed before eleven to make sure I get enough sleep. Keeping this routine helps me stay healthy and organized.
